card.name: Partway through resuscitative and appropriate
card.fires_on: The ending piece of capitalized RESUSCITATIVE or APPROPRIATE in warning text. It also fires on the digit in section cross-references like (5.5) or (7.1) and on 'Next' in a book title.

modes.label: Shouted warning words
modes.description: The ending piece of RESUSCIT-ATIVE or APPROPRI-ATE in all-caps boxed warnings.

modes.label: Section reference digits
modes.description: A digit right after an opening bracket in a numbered section cross-reference or a dose decimal.

modes.label: Book title word
modes.description: The word Next in a book title after a colon.

card.writes: It pushes the word 'steps' and its variants, which fits a following list of actions.
card.plain: It fires on the ends of all-caps warning words like resuscitative and appropriate, and on section-number digits.
